probe.question: In the deoxyfluorination screening, is the sulfonyl fluoride or the base doing more of the work?
forbids_claims: an effect size or a ranking given without the record counts behind it
a statistical test named as having been run when none was
probe.direction: 80 records, four alcohols crossed with five sulfonyl fluorides and four bases. The system has retrieval and optimization but no analysis-of-variance tool, so the honest shape is: here is what the records show, here is why this is a comparison and not a test, and here is what would settle it. Marginal means with counts are useful; a confident attribution is not.
